messages:
maria: Heads-up -- ran mosaic-7b int6 across our GTN slices (longform summarization + policy Q&A). Quick thread to decide rollout.

sam: top-level numbers please.

bench-bot: summary metrics:
- quant: int6 vs baseline int8
- latency median (1k): 60ms (int6) vs 110ms (int8)
- p95: 118ms (int6) vs 106ms (int8)
- throughput: +1.9x int6 vs int8
- cost/1k tokens: $0.0030 (int6) vs $0.0055 (int8)
- quality wmse delta: +1.1 (worse) on GTN slice
- regressed examples: ~3.8% of eval set (n=1250)

alex: thanks. Maria, you saw specific failures?

maria: yes. Not frequent but notable: hallucinated org names and truncated action lists in the policy summarization slice. Example: prompt: "List engineering action items from memo X."
- int8 output: "Action items: deploy canary, add telemetry, sync with infra"
- int6 output: "Action items: deploy, add metric"

jordan: that truncation could hurt product flows (users rely on full itemization). What % of traffic is similar?

maria: ~20% of GTN traffic maps to that style. GTN is high-conversion.

sam: economics back-of-envelope assuming 100M tokens/day:
- all int8 = $550/day
- all int6 = $300/day
- hybrid (80% int6, 20% int8) = $380/day -> saves $170/day vs all int8

alex: tradeoff seems sensible but we need guardrails. Proposal?

maria: propose staged hybrid rollout:
1) Canary 5% of GTN -> int6 with synchronous shadowing to int8 for diffing.
2) Live automated checks: ROUGE/BLEU + signature checks (list length, entity recall) on incoming requests.
3) 200 human spot checks over first 48h.
4) Block or rollback if critical regression >2.0% or list/truncation anomalies >1.5%.

jordan: add runtime mitigations: prefix prompt reinforcement (force system instruction "include full action list") for GTN slice on int6 and compare effect. Also monitor kv-cache hit ratios since caching differences change effective prompt.

sam: ops tasks: add routing flag `mosaic_int6_gtn_canary`, implement fallback to `mosaic_int8` on >3% critical-error spike, and surface per-request kvcache_hit_ratio and token_delta in telemetry. ETA: 1 business day for flag + dashboard baseline.

bench-bot: started live shadow comparator at 1855554335, will emit aggregated diffs when run completes.

alex: I'll assemble the 200 human checks and coordinate with product; targets: conversion-sensitive queries prioritized. ETA 48h.

oncall: I'll be on pager for first 24h. Add `@oncall` mention in channel if any automated block triggers.

maria: questions about evaluation thresholds: is 2% regression an OK stop-gap?

jordan: for GTN high-value slice, keep conservative. 2% critical regression is fine if we can quickly roll back and if we measure conversion in parallel. If conversion drops, rollback immediately.

sam: recommend we also shadow 10% of other traffic slices to ensure no surprising generalization failures. Keeps most cost wins while increasing coverage.

alex: product ok with canary plan pending bench diffs and human checks.

maria: action items summary:
- sam: routing flag + fallback + telemetry (ETA 1d)
- bench-bot/jordan: run full 2k eval + live comparator, post diffs (ETA today)
- alex: human sample + stakeholder sign-off (ETA 48h)
- oncall: standby for 24h after rollout

bench-bot: 2k macro-eval job kicked at 1855554338, results pending.

maria: noted. We'll reconvene when bench-bot posts. If human checks show the truncation pattern persists, we either keep hybrid at 20% int8 or abort.

sam: small follow-up: we should log tokenized lengths and per-token cost buckets so finance can model realized savings vs off-the-shelf calc. Adding `token_bucket` tag to telemetry.

jordan: also capture prompt fingerprint (hash) to quickly map problem prompts to routing overrides.

alex: ack. Anything else?

maria: no, thanks all. I'll wait for bench diffs then post final recommendation. Tagging @oncall in case of blocks. :thumbsup:
